comment: АСТУР scoring formulas (PRO-427). Every result snapshot stores the version it was computed with; a published version is never edited — changing any number means adding a new version and pointing `current` at it. Thresholds are transparent product rules, not norms. `legacy-1` is only used once, to freeze attempts finished before PRO-427 (spatial subtest shown but not counted, as the formula had no spatial scale then). v3 = v2 + Latin vowels in the own-name quick command (a name typed in Latin, e.g. "Arman", was judged as consonant-initial in v2) + text folding (Unicode NFC, ё→е) when matching answers; also the first version with explicit answered/skipped item states. v4 = v3 + answers matched against the keys of every language, element by element (a word set or concept chain may mix ru and kk; open text scores as the best of the per-language scores) — the language can be switched mid-attempt + open-text answers compared with Kazakh letters folded to their Russian look-alikes (қ→к, ғ→г, ә→а, і→и…), since many students type without a Kazakh layout.
